## Boundaries

- [ ] Public-safe inputs and synthetic evidence only; no private content or credentials.
- [ ] Existing decisions preserved; new decisions appended where required.
- [ ] Proof and CI cover the current head/base; gaps are stated.
- [ ] No automatic merge, release, or deployment requested.
